race.title: Karndean Designflooring Mares' Open NH Flat Race (Listed) (GBB Race)
race.verdict: An excellent renewal of this listed bumper. ELEGANTEMENTE created a fine impression when forging 6 lengths clear of the reopposing She Was The One on her debut at Ballinrobe in August and, with much better to come, is taken to maintain her unbeaten record up in grade. Soleretta must be held in some regard by her yard for Harry Skelton to side with her over Northern Singer , who landed a recent Chepstow bumper in good style. Miss Master and impressive Stratford winner Gypsy Sky are also feared. ELEGANTEMENTE (FR) SOLERETTA (IRE) MISS MASTER
